        print(pow(total_points, total_points - 1, MOD))

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    while (T--) {
        int total_points, multiplier;
        cin >> total_points >> multiplier;
        vector<int> sequence(total_points);
        for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
            sequence[i] = (multiplier * i) % total_points;
        }

        if (multiplier == 0) {
            long long result = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
                result = (result * total_points) % MOD;
            }
            cout << result << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        vector<bool> visited_nodes(total_points, false);
        vector<int> cycle_size_count(total_points + 1, 0);
        long long answer = 1;

        for (int node = 0; node < total_points; ++node) {
            if (visited_nodes[node]) continue;
            int count = 0;
            int current_node = node;
            while (!visited_nodes[current_node]) {
                visited_nodes[current_node] = true;
                current_node = sequence[current_node];
                ++count;
            }
            cycle_size_count[count]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < total_points; ++size) {
            if (cycle_size_count[size] != 0) {
                long long total = (long long)size * cycle_size_count[size];
                if (size > 1) total += cycle_size_count[1];
                long long temp = 1;
                long long base = total % MOD;
                long long exp = cycle_size_count[size];
                long long b = base;
                long long e = exp;
                while (e > 0) {
                    if (e & 1) temp = (temp * b) % MOD;
                    b = (b * b) % MOD;
                    e >>= 1;
                }
                answer = (answer * temp) % MOD;
            }
        }

        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
